title: SAML 2.0 trust-provisioning flow with admin attestation and audit hooks
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Implement a secure SAML 2.0 trust provisioning and validation flow that ties IdP metadata ingestion to RBAC v2 role bindings, requires admin attestation before enabling, and emits structured audit logs for every change and probe. This ticket covers API surface, backend validation, attestation handshake, audit hooks, error semantics for the console UX, and the rollout plan (feature flag + canary).
acceptance_criteria: Admin can add an IdP via URL/file/manual entry and must complete an attestation step before trust is active
Metadata validation rejects invalid or unsigned metadata and provides actionable errors in the UI
SAML probe dry-run mode verifies assertion mapping and reports mismatches without changing RBAC bindings
All provisioning actions (create/update/delete/probe) write structured audit log entries with actor, timestamp, entity_id, action, and result
RBAC role mapping preview shows suggested role bindings based on attribute mappings and allows manual override
Feature gated rollout completed: 5% canary → 25% → 100% with rollback metric thresholds defined
comments: 2025-01-16 — Kickoff: scoped to metadata ingestion, validation, attestation, RBAC binding preview, and audit log schema. UX design ticket created (DES-4321). Priya to draft attestation UX flows.
2025-01-21 — Decision: use python-xmlsec (server-side) for signature validation rather than a homegrown parser. Security reviewed trade-offs: library updates must be tracked. (see confluence link)

2025-01-24 — Implementation note: will validate metadata signature when provided; if metadata URL is used, fetcher must enforce TLS + cert pinning optional. Miguel to add fetcher timeout/retry heuristics to prevent blocking control plane threads.

2025-01-28 — Prototype: added a dry-run 'probe' that performs simulated SAML login using a replayed assertion; returns assertion->RBAC mapping errors. Test harness PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4621

2025-01-30 — Security feedback: require admin attestation be an interactive login from the admin user at the IdP to confirm subject mapping; plain checkbox approval is insufficient. Evan Zhang suggested a signed challenge flow; MVP will use a one-time login token embedded in AssertionConsumerService URL to validate admin identity.

2025-02-01 — UX review: design asked for clearer failure states: 'metadata signature mismatch', 'duplicate ACS endpoints', 'entityID normalization conflict', and 'cert expiration < 30 days' warnings. Miguel to update error classification mapping for telemetry.

2025-02-02 — QA plan: unit tests for xmlsig verification, e2e tests with test IdP (SimpleSAMLphp), and a mutation test that corrupts signatures. Also add a load test for metadata URL fetching (rate limit probes to 1/s per customer).
